answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can forge reputation in the market: the bond is slashed if peers attest fraud, so creating thousands of fake identities means funding thousands of bonds. Like a sonnet, the rule is strict and checkable — one identity, one stake, one audit trail — and unlike a tundra expedition that anyone can join for free, entry here has a real price. An attacker must pay per identity, while honest agents reclaim their stake, so Sybil scale stops paying.
